name: Randel Tales
source:
In a fantastical land named Astylla, a constant war against the Demon King's Army has been waged for over 400 years. Just 15 years ago the Demon King was slain, yet the war has not stopped and it seems that the Demon army is slowly getting stronger.

You play as an orphaned 19-year-old man who was taken in by a merchant when he was 4 and currently lives in the town of Randel. Now that he's come of age, he is enlisted in the Academy and joins the Adventurer's Guild, becoming an adventurer like he has always dreamed of... and getting laid much, much more than he could ever have dreamed of.

From elves to dwarves, from shy childhood friends to mean redheads, from nympho guards to pure town girls, the town of Randel truly has it all.

[From [url=https://erosandwich.itch.io/randel-tales]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一片名叫阿斯提拉的奇幻土地上，与魔王军的战争已经持续了400多年。十五年前，魔王被杀，但战争却并未停止，魔族大军似乎正在慢慢壮大。

你扮演一名19岁的孤儿，四岁时被商人收养，目前住在兰德尔镇。现在他已经成年了，他入读了学院，并加入了冒险家公会，成为了他一直梦想的冒险家……并且得到了比他梦想的更多、更多的上床。

从精灵到矮人，从害羞的儿时朋友到刻薄的红发女郎，从花痴守卫到纯洁的小镇女孩，兰德尔小镇确实拥有一切。

[来自[url=https://erosandwich.itch.io/randel-tales]Itch.io[/url]]
